location_exception_reason: Tensile membrane structures are engineered architectural systems quoted per square foot of covered area and custom-designed to site specifications; location names in titles (e.g., 'Mumbai Car Parking Tensile Structure') add no product information and are redundant with project-level metadata already captured in RFQ and seller profile.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Contractor', 'Installer') are already exposed by IndiaMART's seller business-type filter and do not change what the product is; removing them leaves the title complete and accurate (e.g., 'PVC Tensile Membrane Car Parking Structure' is identical in meaning whether sold by a Manufacturer or Contractor).
